title: Gen 3 car without antenna (south-central)
description: In Finnish Gen 3 coverage, a car with no antenna at all points to the south-central part of the country (roughly from the Helsinki area up through Häme and Päijät-Häme to the south of Central Finland and Southern Savonia). A Gen 3 car with an antenna tilted to the left points to the southwest coast instead.

title: Gen 3 car with tilted antenna (southwest)
description: In Finnish Gen 3 coverage, a car with an antenna tilted to the left points to the southwest coast (from Turku north along the coast through Satakunta towards Ostrobothnia). A Gen 3 car with no antenna points to the south-central part of the country instead.
